subject: Hosting mode recommendation & cross-region routing constraints for OrientBank pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Patel <ananya.patel@orientbank.sg>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@orientbank.sg>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: hosting constraints and pilot next steps

Hi Ananya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

Summary of needs (what I heard):
- Residency: Singapore (SG) for SG customers; some EU-bound traffic must remain in EU for GDPR/PD-related customers.
- Security: customer-managed VPC preferred; HSM/KMS BYOK (for encryption of tokens/keys).
- Latency: production tail latency target ~<100ms for Singapore region.
- Compliance: PCI scope for a subset of requests; SOC2 evidence required for procurement.

Options we discussed: Hosted API (fastest to start) vs Dedicated capacity in SG (reserved GPU pools) vs Private VPC (customer-managed networking).

Open questions from our side:
- Can your security team share the network/peering constraints (CIDR, egress rules) and any mandatory firewall rules?
- Is there a hard requirement that no SG customer data may leave Singapore at any time (including backups/replication)?

Attachments: I’ve attached a short outline of Redwood Private deployment steps and our SOC2 summary for your security team to review (SOC2_Type2_Redwood.pdf, redwood-private-deploy-outline.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra/security + our solutions engineering (30–45m) — propose Thu 17 Jun or Fri 18 Jun.
2) While Private VPC is provisioned (~6–8 weeks typical), we can provision Dedicated reserved capacity within SG as an intermediate to meet latency & isolation needs.
3) We’ll prepare a preliminary mutual action plan and an estimated cost delta between Dedicated vs Private.

If that aligns, I’ll loop in Prio (solutions) and Laura (SE) to coordinate the technical meeting.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
viv.k@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: hosting constraints and pilot next steps

Vivek — quick internal notes from my side (SE perspective) after listening to the call recording:

Technical feasibility and recommended pathway:
- Private VPC (customer-managed): meets strict residency and BYOK/HSM needs. Requires VPC peering or private interconnects; our control plane can sit in a Redwoods-managed region while inference nodes live inside the customer's VPC (we support Dedicated and Private options). Typical provisioning: 4–8 weeks depending on security reviews and network approvals.
- Dedicated capacity (Redwood-managed in SG): much faster to spin up (hours-days for reserved nodes). Provides isolated GPU pools and tenant separation but does not provide customer-managed VPC or BYOK HSM inside customer infra. Good stop-gap to meet latency SLA while Private is provisioned.
- Hosted (multi-tenant): not acceptable if they require guaranteed residency + BYOK.

Cross-region routing considerations:
- We can route requests by geo-IP or token metadata. For EU users, requests can be routed to EU nodes; for SG, to SG nodes. Important: if data cannot cross borders at all, we must ensure no asynchronous replication or global logs contain PII that leaves the region.
- Backups & logs: needs configuration to ensure logs retained in-region; we can separate logging storage per region and support in-region backups.

Security blockers to resolve before Private deploy:
1) Network: IP ranges, required inbound/outbound ports, VPN or Direct Connect details.
2) KMS/HSM: BYOK workflow and certificate exchange.
3) Audit: SOC2 report, penetration test summary, and support for audit evidence.

Suggested immediate actions:
- Ask customer to share orientbank-network-reqs.xlsx (network CIDRs + egress rules).
- Schedule the technical deep-dive (I can lead).
- Prepare a cost delta: Dedicated (SG) vs Private VPC (baseline + setup fee).

I'll join the meeting; Laura can handle PKI/HSM details.

— Priyom (SE)
From: Ananya Patel <ananya.patel@orientbank.sg>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <it-security@orientbank.sg>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@orientbank.sg>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:58:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting constraints and pilot next steps

Vivek / team — thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our security and compliance blockers so we can move the procurement forward:

Non-negotiable requirements:
- All data for SG customers must persist and be processed within Singapore (no cross-border replication or backups outside SG). This is mandated by our legal team under PDPA and our PCI assessor.
- Customer-managed VPC preferred. We require HSM/BYOK for key material.
- Access controls: strict role-based access and admin audit logs retained in-region for 12 months.

Operational asks:
- Timeline: if Private VPC truly takes 6–8 weeks, please confirm whether Redwood can provision a Dedicated cluster in SG for the pilot (with contractual guarantees about no cross-border failover) while Private is stood up. We need functional isolation and predictable latency for the pilot in 8 weeks.
- Air-gapped/on-prem option: do you support an on-prem package for a regulated environment? If so, high-level list of prerequisites would be helpful.

I’ve attached our network requirements spreadsheet (orientbank-network-reqs.xlsx) with our internal firewall rules and peering notes. Please have your network/infra team review and confirm any gaps.

Also: procurement requires SOC2 Type II and a copy of any recent penetration test summaries — please share.

Thanks — Ananya
Head of Cloud Platform, OrientBank
Ananya.Patel@orientbank.sg
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Patel <ananya.patel@orientbank.sg>

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: hosting constraints and pilot next steps

Ananya — thanks, that is very clear and helpful. Confirming next steps from Redwood side: 

1) Technical deep-dive: Priyom + Laura to lead. I’ll send a Calendly invite to your infra and security leads for Thu 24 Jun / Fri 25 Jun. (Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-technical-dive)

2) Interim approach: we will provision Dedicated reserved capacity in SG as an intermediate to meet latency and isolation while Private VPC is provisioned. Commitment: we will enforce region-restricted failover rules so no SG tenant traffic is routed outside SG during the pilot. I’ve asked Priyom to prepare a short note on operational controls that enforce in-region processing/logging.

3) Compliance artifacts: attaching SOC2_Type2_Redwood.pdf and our redwood-private-deploy-outline.pdf. We will also provide a pentest summary under NDA — I’ll get legal to check the right sharing flow.

4) Timeline & mutual action plan: goal is POC in 8 weeks. Immediate blockers: signed DPA + network approvals. We’ll draft an MAP and share by EOD Mon 21 Jun.

5) Owners: Vivek (deal lead), Priyom (SE/technical), Laura (PKI/HSM), Markus (escalation / approvals).

If that sounds good I’ll circulate the MAP and the time options for the deep-dive. Thanks again — Vivek
